objective: Verify exactness and repeat stability, explicitly excluding any host tolerance such as the sample 0.15f comparison.
observation: Obtain the future Ascend-C candidate artifact, run the repeated launches on Ascend 950PR, and capture every odata buffer.
pass_condition: Pass iff all three outputs are bitwise identical to each other and to the host oracle; any nonzero deviation fails.
setup: Run the candidate three times with the same input and shifts; compute host oracle; compare all outputs bitwise.
